name: Aylés

climate: Garnacha, Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Mezalocha, Aragón. Its rules allow Cabernet Sauvignon, Garnacha Tinta, Merlot and Tempranillo, and since a recent change also Syrah and Chardonnay, for white and rosé as well as red.
